clusters.label: Strategic Discipline for AI-Augmented Decision-Making
clusters.rationale: Unique concept about treating decision-making as a strategic discipline before AI integration; no other candidate matches same idea and level.

clusters.label: Preserving Human Agency in AI Decisions
clusters.rationale: Focuses on concrete implementation to maintain human agency; distinct from other candidates.

clusters.label: Human Purpose and Judgment as Irreplaceable by AI
clusters.rationale: Emphasizes the irreplaceable nature of human judgment; separate from implementation or agency-preservation candidates.

clusters.label: Building Decision-Making Competence for Humans and AI
clusters.rationale: Concerns developing human skills and measuring AI performance; no tight match with others.

clusters.label: Risk-Based AI Agency Level
clusters.rationale: Specific calibration rule based on risk; distinct from broader strategic or classification concepts.

clusters.label: Decision Classification Framework
clusters.rationale: A multidimensional taxonomy for decisions; unique in scope and not equivalent to agency or competence topics.
